newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank says crown currently undervalued.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank says crown currently undervalued.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Thursday that it saw the crown as being currently undervalued.
"Studies carried out by the Riksbank show that the crown is currently undervalued in the long-term fundamental sense," the Riksbank said in its quarterly inflation report.
The bank said it therefore considered the recent weakening in the local unit to be temporary.

The Riksbank said the Trade Currency Weighted (TCW) Index, used to measure the strength of the crown was currently at 122. The bank has previously suggested that a level between 109 and 118 in real terms would be appropriate.
The Riksbank does not have a target level for the crown.
At 0830 GMT the crown was trading at 4.4800 to the mark.
